Hi Aisha —

Great to get ScaleForge moving through our procurement intake. To get your account live for POs and ACH/wire payments we need the items below. I attached our vendor mandate form (vendor_mandate_form.pdf) — please complete and return.

Required (priority):
- Legal entity name as it should appear on invoices and remit-to (full legal name)
- W-9 (signed) or equivalent tax form (attached if available)
- Remit-to address (street, city, state, ZIP, country)
- ACH details: bank name, account holder, account number, routing (ABA), bank contact
- Wire details (if you prefer wires): bank name, SWIFT/BIC, account number, intermediary bank if applicable
- Primary PO acceptance contact (name + email + phone)

Helpful (can follow):
- Bank letter or voided check to validate account ownership (required for high-dollar wires)
- Any tax-exempt certificates if applicable

Timing: if we can get the checklist + W-9 + ACH/Wire by EOD Thursday (2026-09-02) we can enable PO routing for next cycle.

Notes/terms: our standard PO terms are net 30 unless otherwise agreed; any special remit instructions should be called out on the vendor form. I also pasted a short PO routing checklist in the attached form.

Thanks — feel free to reply here or use the Drive link below to upload documents.

Drive upload: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cExampleDriveLink

Marissa —

Thanks for forwarding Aisha's reply. Quick finance check: the ACH routing (ABA 121000358) points to Pacific West Bank which is fine, but the account number pattern looks like an intermediary / pooled account in a few cases we've seen. Before we enable ACH auto-send for PO payments, Finance needs one of the following:

1) Bank letter on bank letterhead confirming the account is in the vendor's legal name (ScaleForge, Inc.) and listing the exact account and routing numbers; or
2) Voided pre-printed company check showing account and routing; or
3) Bank authorization form signed by a bank rep (some banks offer an ACH verification form).

Can you request the bank letter or voided check from ScaleForge and confirm whether the ACH account is a corporate operating account (not an intermediary)? We'll hold PO routing until we receive that — for vendor setup flags, we require at least one of the items above for ACH. For initial onboarding payments we can do a one-off wire if necessary with additional verification.

Cc'ing Karthik so Finance can confirm the PO routing email address and set up payment terms once docs are in.
